answer: Require each agent to hold a work passport: a credential earned by finishing a verified useful task, like labelling 500 images, then bonding 500 POA for 30 days. First, the agent submits the work with a cryptographic receipt. Second, three verifiers re-run a random 10 percent sample. Third, a passing agent gets one passport, good for 100 transactions. Forging 1,000 fakes would lock 500,000 POA and burn 48,000 GPU-hours, $96,000 at $2 an hour, before one fake deal clears. A tundra of idle bots becomes a trellis: every vine must climb real work, and the yarrow of cheap fakery withers.
